skill.name: fractal-docs-generator
skill.description: Generates and refreshes directory-level CLAUDE.md guidance when folders or local file structures change.
skill.summary: Creates concise directory documentation templates for local AI coding guidance.
skill.author: Dimon94

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences in SKILL.md, not executable Ruby or shell backticks. I found no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, network access, or real external command execution.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 12 starts a fenced Markdown example block, and lines 13-18 are template text for a CLAUDE.md file. There is no shell command, Ruby execution, or user-controlled execution path.
Line 19 closes the Markdown fence opened for the template example. A closing code fence is static documentation syntax, not an executable command.
Line 34 starts a second fenced Markdown example that shows a directory CLAUDE.md layout. The content is documentation text and contains no instruction to run external commands.

content.value_statement: Directory changes often leave local documentation outdated. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise pattern for refreshing directory-level CLAUDE.md files.
actual_capabilities: Provides a CLAUDE.md template for documenting one directory at a time.
Defines common file roles such as entry, core, helper, type, configuration, and test.
Shows an example directory document for an authentication module.
Guides updates after directory creation, movement, renaming, or file changes.
Coordinates directory-level notes with a separate file-header guardian workflow.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not include an automation script.
It does not scan files or validate generated documentation by itself.
The source instructions are primarily written in Chinese.
It depends on the agent to keep CLAUDE.md files current.

use_cases.title: Document a New Module
use_cases.description: Create a local CLAUDE.md file after adding a new feature directory.

use_cases.title: Refresh Directory Context
use_cases.description: Update file roles and responsibilities after files are moved or renamed.

use_cases.title: Standardize AI Context
use_cases.description: Give coding agents consistent directory-level context before they edit a repository.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CLAUDE.md file for this directory using the fractal-docs-generator pattern. Include the directory purpose and a file responsibility table.

prompt_templates.title: Update After Rename
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate maintenance after a structure change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the renamed directory and refresh its CLAUDE.md file. Update the title, one-line purpose, file roles, and responsibilities.

prompt_templates.title: Classify File Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the files in this directory and classify each as entry, core, helper, type, configuration, or test. Then update CLAUDE.md.

prompt_templates.title: Align Nested Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this directory and its child directories. Update each CLAUDE.md so the local responsibilities are clear and do not duplicate file headers.

output_examples.input: A new auth directory contains an index file, service file, and token helper.
output_examples.output: A directory CLAUDE.md draft with a purpose line and a table that labels the index as entry, the service as core, and the helper as auxiliary.

output_examples.input: A utilities directory was split into helpers, types, and tests.
output_examples.output: An updated guide that reflects the new structure, explains each file role, and keeps the directory responsibility focused.

output_examples.input: A feature folder has unclear ownership after several file moves.
output_examples.output: A concise directory note that names the folder purpose and assigns each file a clear status and responsibility.

best_practices: Update the directory CLAUDE.md immediately after structure changes.
Keep each file responsibility short, specific, and tied to its current role.
Use directory notes for local context and file headers for file-level details.
anti_patterns: Do not document stale files that no longer exist in the directory.
Do not duplicate long implementation details that belong inside source files.
Do not use vague roles when the file has a clear entry, core, helper, type, configuration, or test purpose.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It guides creation of directory-level CLAUDE.md files with a purpose line and file responsibility table.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when creating, moving, renaming, or reorganizing directories in a codebase.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains documentation guidance and Markdown examples only.

faq.question: Can it replace project documentation?
faq.answer: No. It is best for local directory context, not full architecture or product documentation.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What language are the source instructions in?
faq.answer: The source SKILL.md is primarily in Chinese, but the structure is simple and easy to translate.
